controls: Separate verification, distinct from the worker

correction_policy.rule: Substantiated corrections are appended and the prior claim is preserved as superseded, not removed.

does_not_prove: External customer adoption, revenue, or third-party production deployments
Certification of any kind, including SOC 2
Any universal comparison of AI coding tools or model vendors
Any dollar cost or token spend figure

evidence_grades.CONCEPT: A depiction of the intended product. Not a recording, not evidence, and never counted as a demonstration.
evidence_grades.NOT_MEASURED: Not yet instrumented. Stated as unknown rather than estimated.
evidence_grades.OWNER_OBSERVED: Reported by the operator; not independently measured here.
evidence_grades.REPOSITORY_SUPPORTED: Recorded in an immutable repository or CI record; not a full customer-path pass.
evidence_grades.VERIFIED_RECEIPT: Bound to a dated run with a published, hash-identified artifact.

hosting.alternative: A hosted MP4 reachable over HTTPS. Cloudflare Pages caps a single file at 25 MiB, so a long or high-bitrate recording must not be committed to this repository.
hosting.never: Do not commit video files to git. They bloat the repository and fight the per-file deploy limit.
hosting.preferred: Cloudflare Stream — the account already runs on Cloudflare and Stream handles transcoding, adaptive bitrate and its own player.

publish_a_concept_film: A concept film is never graded as evidence and never appears in the recorded-demonstrations section.
Keep the vision modifier on the player so the CONCEPT marker stays over the frame, including in screenshots and crops.
Set the source exactly as for a recording, then set media_state to PUBLISHED on the product_vision case.
Do not add a receipt for it. A concept film has no run behind it, and inventing one would defeat the page.
The shooting script and its boundaries are in docs/demo-video/VISION-SCRIPT.md.
publish_a_recording: Confirm the run shown in the recording produced a receipt. No recording is published before its evidence exists.
Upload the file to Cloudflare Stream and copy the iframe URL it returns.
On the case slot in /proof/lab/index.html, set data-video-embed to that URL (or data-video-src for a hosted MP4). Set nothing else.
Mirror the same URL into this file under the case's media object, and set media_state to PUBLISHED.
Add the backing receipt to the receipts array and swap the case caption's NOT YET PUBLISHED pill for the receipt grade.
maintenance.rule: A recorded-demonstration slot stays empty until its run has produced a receipt. A product-vision slot is always marked CONCEPT and is never counted as evidence.

cost_per_accepted_outcome.note: Measured per accepted outcome, not per successful model call.

per_run_spend_ceiling.note: Will be stated once enforced in the runtime and provable from a receipt.

total_token_spend.note: Explicitly unknown in the current evidence bundles.

proves: A single indexed location where demonstrations, receipts, measurement state and roadmap status are kept together
That published failures are preserved alongside published passes
That unmeasured quantities are labelled rather than estimated

take_policy: A reshoot replaces a case's media, never its identity. Each take keeps its own version, release tag and sha256 so two recordings of the same case can be compared later. A superseded take stays listed with the reason it was replaced; it is never deleted, and the current take is the one marked CURRENT.
